text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #40122 is next in the merge queue but CI keeps failing on integration/session-locker (shard 12). Holding merge for now. Anyone able to take a quick look?

ci-bot: CI summary for PR 40122 — build: failed, failing shard: 12, failure type: flaky-test?
• job: integration/sessions (shard 12)
• last run: 3 consecutive failures in 2 hours
• logs: https://ci.internal/reports/40122/shard12 (internal)

maya: I can try a targeted rerun on shard 12. If it's just flakiness we should avoid rerunning the entire queue.

alex: Thanks. Targeted rerun sounds good. If it repros consistently we should block until we have a fix or a reliable workaround.

sam: Seen this one before — looks like a race during KV init when tests run in parallel. Increasing test timeout to 10s reduced frequency in my local repro. Patch idea: add a `wait_for_ready()` with a short backoff in the test harness.

maya: Running targeted rerun now: `/rerun-ci --pr=40122 --shard=12`

ci-bot: Targeted rerun queued (PR 40122, shard 12). Attempt 4/6.

ci-bot: Targeted rerun complete — failed. Sample failing stack:
```
E       AssertionError: session not established within 5s
  tests/integration/test_session_lifecycle.py:88: AssertionError
  File "/runner/work/repo/tests/integration/test_session_lifecycle.py", line 86, in test_session_locking
    client.wait_for_session(timeout=5)
  File "/runner/work/repo/tests/support/client.py", line 42, in wait_for_session
    raise RuntimeError("session init timed out")
```

maya: Ugh, still failing. Sam, can you share the local repro steps again?

sam: Sure — run `pytest tests/integration/test_session_lifecycle.py::test_session_locking -k shard12 -n 1` with `KV_DEBUG=1`. Locally I saw the timeout ~90% when test harness didn't backoff. Quick patch: in `tests/support/client.py` change `wait_for_session(timeout=5)` -> `wait_for_session(timeout=10)` and add small retry loop.

lindsey: If it's a known flaky and reruns aren't stabilizing, we should put a short-term skip on shard 12 so the merge queue can progress. Add `@flaky` or `@skip_on_shard(12)` until a proper fix lands. I'll add `needs-flake-bisect` label on the PR.

alex: I don't love skips but agree for merge momentum. Can we do skip + create a follow-up issue to remove the skip within 7 days?

lindsey: Yep — I'll open an issue and add assignee.

maya: I can apply the skip to the test and push a tiny PR (ci-only) that just adjusts the timeout/skip. Want me to do that or prefer a proper rollback?

sam: Go ahead with the minimal runtime fix (timeout + retry) as a stopgap. We'll open a follow-up to implement robust init detection.

alex: Ok — maya, please create the ci-only PR and ping here when ready. I'll hold the merge until we see a green targeted run or the skip PR lands.

ci-bot: Note: PR 40122 has 1 required approval outstanding. Merge will proceed automatically once checks and approvals are satisfied.

maya: Created PR 40123 (ci: session-locker stabilize) with timeout/retry, and a test skip for shard 12. Link: https://ci.internal/pr/40123 (internal). Requesting quick review. :eyes:

sam: Reviewing now. If green I can approve.

ci-bot: PR 40123 build: running (targeted).

ci-bot: PR 40123 build: success.

sam: Approving PR 40123. :thumbsup:

lindsey: Added `needs-flake-bisect` label to PR 40122 and opened issue INF-789 to track permanent fix.

ci-bot: PR 40122 — targeted rerun scheduled again after CI-only PR merged. Attempting another run on shard 12.

ci-bot: Targeted rerun complete — shard 12: success.

alex: Great — unblocking the merge queue. I'll requeue PR 40122 for merge window. Thanks everyone.

maya: great teamwork. I'll follow up on INF-789 with notes from local repro. :sparkles:
